sources.build: STRATZ Divine-Immortal pos1, 2026-10-13 (data/meta/stratz_builds.json): Falcon Blade ~7 min, Manta Style ~17, Eye of Skadi ~28, Hurricane Pike ~29.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar (135), Bloodthorn (250), Eye of Skadi (160), Butterfly (139), Hurricane Pike (263), Hydra's Breath (1858), Daedalus (141). Recipes: OpenDota constants (Hydra's Breath and Hurricane Pike are both built from Dragon Lance).
sources.hero: Valve /datafeed/herodata hero_id 109: melee (150 range); Conjure Image and Metamorphosis illusions are Terrorblade's controlled units.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-17: against illusions Butterfly, and Dragon Lance goes into Hydra's Breath instead of Hurricane Pike; Pike against heroes who jump on him; far ahead, the tempo build Manta, Skadi, Butterfly, Daedalus, then Aegis and the throne.
sources.games: OpenDota Explorer, 617 league games with Terrorblade in patch 7.41 (2026-03-24..2026-10-17), gold timelines: he wins 86-100% with 12.5k+ gold by 20:00 (52-56% at 10-12k), 94% with 17.5k+ by 25:00 (84.7% at 17k), 85% with 22k+ by 30:00; net worth is ~0.96 of that gold. Dragon Lance is his third item in 87% of games. Against Phantom Assassin or Windranger, Monkey King Bar in 45% (12% otherwise); with an escape hero too, Bloodthorn 12% (5%), won 67% against 50%. Against illusion heroes Butterfly 51% (38%), Hurricane Pike 18% (44%), Maelstrom 0%. Against healing heroes Eye of Skadi 70% (61%) at the same ~27 min. Against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar Silver Edge 42% (7%), won 70% against 43%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py terrorblade.

rules.name: Bloodthorn
rules.basis: Soul Rend silences for 5 s (no Blink, Ball Lightning...) and gives True Strike to your attacks and your controlled units' attacks on the silenced target; its passive pierces evasion on 40% of attacks. One item answers both heroes.

rules.name: Monkey King Bar
rules.basis: Pierce: 80% of attacks go through evasion with 70 magic damage, nothing to cast. Against evasion alone it is cheaper (5000 against 6400) and always on.

rules.name: Eye of Skadi
rules.basis: Eye of Skadi is in Terrorblade's usual build and its attacks cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s: against heavy healing keep it in the build (high-rank players buy it more often, at the same ~27 min) rather than an off-build Spirit Vessel.

rules.name: Butterfly
rules.basis: Butterfly: 35% evasion, so about a third of the illusions' attacks miss him; it is also in his tempo build.

rules.name: Hydra's Breath
rules.basis: Hydra's Breath (Dragon Lance + Specialist's Array + Orb of Venom): 30% of ranged attacks also fire at up to 3 nearby enemies, and Miasma poisons each one hit for 2.5% of max HP per second. Terrorblade attacks from range in Metamorphosis, so the Dragon Lance goes into it instead of Hurricane Pike.

rules.name: Hurricane Pike
rules.basis: Hurricane Thrust: pushes him and the target 425 apart, then 5 attacks on it from any range with +100 attack speed for 5 s. In his STRATZ build at ~29 min.

build_basis: The order of all 325 won Terrorblade games in the 7.41 league games above (share of games, median minute): Power Treads 100% (6), Falcon Blade 84% (8), Manta Style 100% (16), Aghanim's Shard 83% (17), Dragon Lance 92% (19), Eye of Skadi 70% (27), Hurricane Pike 44% (27), Butterfly 48% (29), Black King Bar 37% (33), Daedalus 28% (35). It replaces the all-ranks OpenDota popularity (Manta Style, Eye of Skadi, Hurricane Pike, Butterfly, then BKB, Crystalys, Daedalus) for him. Pike is skipped once the Dragon Lance went into Hydra's Breath. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py terrorblade.

tempo.basis: His own net worth over this curve (12.5k, 17.5k and 22k gold by 20, 25 and 30 min in the games above, ~0.96 of it as net worth): he wins ~85% of those games. A player's GSI shows no enemy net worth, so his own farm stands for «their carry is poor». Then the counters wait: the tempo build, the Aegis and the throne.
tempo.order: The order of the 72 won games with 12.5k+ gold by 20:00 (share of games, median minute): Manta Style 100% (15), Aghanim's Shard 78% (16), Dragon Lance 93% (18), Eye of Skadi 62% (25), Butterfly 50% (24), Daedalus 25% (30).

never.label: Sunder Minimum HP Swap
never.basis: Player review 2026-10-17: never take it (175 of 584 games did, won 62%, a confounded minority).

instead.name: special_bonus_all_stats_10
instead.label: +10 All Attributes
instead.basis: Player review 2026-10-17: +10 All Attributes when illusions die easily. In the same games the share of +10 All Attributes rises with the enemy heroes whose area damage or Hex clears illusions: 11% with none (237 games), 31% with one (158), 44% with two or more (50).

skills.basis: 634 Terrorblade games of the 7.41 league data (OpenDota Explorer ability_upgrades_arr), instead of the 3-5 recent pro games: maxed Conjure Image → Metamorphosis → Reflection in 62% (won 56%), Conjure Image maxed first in 560; first point Conjure Image in 463 (Metamorphosis at level 2 in 82%). Sunder at 6 in 49% and at 7-9 in 45%, won 53% and 52%: the level-6 ultimate tip stays. Talents: 10 Conjure Image Cooldown 99%; 15 Metamorphosis Cooldown 70% (Sunder HP 30%); 20 Conjure Image Duration 78% (+10 All Attributes 22%); 25 Metamorphosis Duration 63% of 63 games. The order does not change against illusion heroes (Conjure Image first in 87% of those games, 88% of the rest). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py terrorblade.
